title: The Counterfactual Cost of Exclusion: Mental Health and Keystone Individuals in Human Knowledge Networks
domain: science of science / computational social science / cultural analytics / mental-health stigma
summary: A counterfactual network study estimating how much scientific, intellectual, and cultural production could be lost when people with well-documented mental-health conditions are prevented from participating in knowledge production, explicitly allowing for historical substitution, network rewiring, and uncertainty in retrospective evidence.
